cub3d.name: cub3D
cub3d.title: cub3D, in the browser
cub3d.description: cub3D, a 42 (1337) pair project in C with MLX42, draws a maze by raycasting. This is its own maps/map.cub, rebuilt with three.js: a texture per wall side (NO, SO, WE, EA), floor and ceiling colors from F and C, a door and a minimap.
cub3d.canvasLabel: First-person view of the map.cub maze: textured walls, orange floor, red ceiling

welcome.title: Welcome to cub3D
welcome.body: A 42 project inspired by Wolfenstein 3D, which casts one ray per screen column. The room straight ahead has walls about me.
keys: Esc: free the mouse, Esc again to close

panels.welcomeBody: The cub3D map file, walked in your browser. The other walls are about me.

sr.doorBlocked: Something is in the doorway: the door stays open.

fdf.name: FdF
fdf.title: FdF, in the browser
fdf.description: FdF, a 42 project in C with MiniLibX, draws a heightmap as a wireframe: here six of its test_maps, 42.fdf first. The original draws white lines in an isometric view (grid turned 45°, height halved), or each point's own color when the file gives one, and moves, zooms, rotates and changes the height; this version adds altitude colors and perspective.
fdf.help: Drag: move · right-drag or two fingers: turn · wheel or + −: zoom · arrows: move · R, Shift+R: rotate · P: projection · M, Shift+M: map

game.title: Game Mode
game.description: The portfolio as a first-person mission, built on cub3D: six rooms, one for each section of the profile, threats to neutralize between them, and terminals that open the live demos.
game.canvasLabel: First-person view of the command center: six dark rooms, one for each section of the portfolio, joined by blast doors
game.desktopOnly: FPS Game Mode is optimized for desktop. Use standard scroll view on mobile.
game.briefing: A DevOps command center in six rooms: About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Education and Contact. Read each room's terminal; neutralize the threats on the way.
game.objective: Your mission: six rooms, one section of my profile in each: About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Education and Contact. Walk up to each room's wall terminal and press E to read it. The lit path on the floor shows the way to the next one.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Mission complete
mission.body: You found all six sections: who I am, what I can do, what I have built, where I have worked, where I learned, and how to reach me. Thanks for playing.
mission.bodyThreats: You neutralized every threat in the facility, and the systems are secure. Thanks for playing.

keys: W A S D (Z Q S D on AZERTY): move · ← →: turn
Mouse: look around (click the view to capture it)
Click or F: fire · 1 2 3 or Q (A on AZERTY): switch weapon
E: interact with doors, walls, terminals and the crew
Space: open the door ahead · M: sound on or off
Memory Leak: slows you down · Zero-Day: only seen in your flashlight’s beam

panels.contactBody: Opens a channel: the contact form.

game.aimEnemy: {name}: click or press F to shoot

helm.title: Threat Neutralized!
helm.body: Fun Fact: I use Helm charts to package and deploy complex Kubernetes applications.

tenants.title: Injection Blocked!
tenants.body: Fun Fact: My Django backends use django-tenants for secure, schema-level multi-tenant isolation.

argocd.title: DDoS Mitigated!
argocd.body: Fun Fact: I implement GitOps with Argo CD for declarative, auditable cluster state management.

ansible.title: Exploit Patched!
ansible.body: Fun Fact: I write modular Ansible playbooks to automate secure, reproducible server hardening.

observability.title: Breach Prevented!
observability.body: Fun Fact: My observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) detects infrastructure anomalies in real-time.

terraform.title: Attack Repelled!
terraform.body: Fun Fact: I use Terraform to provision AWS infrastructure with strict IAM security policies.

falco.title: Virus Quarantined!
falco.body: Fun Fact: I deploy Falco for runtime security monitoring and syscall threat detection in K3s.

traefik.title: Threat Neutralized!
traefik.body: Fun Fact: I mitigate DDoS using Traefik rate limiting and Fail2Ban.

pgbouncer.title: Injection Blocked!
pgbouncer.body: Fun Fact: I use parameterized queries and PgBouncer for secure DB pooling.

game.textIntro: The command center's rooms as plain text, without the 3D view.
game.story: Year: 2026. Role: Lead DevOps Engineer. Mission: Navigate the infrastructure, neutralize DDoS and Injection threats, and secure the core systems. Use your arsenal to explore the facility.
game.contrastOn: High contrast on: flat bright colors, no fog or effects.
game.recharging: Recharging: wait for the energy bar to refill.
game.integrityLow: Integrity low: back away from the threats.

sysadmin.name: Senior SysAdmin
sysadmin.line: Hey! Did you know I use Argo CD for all my GitOps pipelines? Keeps the cluster state perfectly synced.
sysadmin.hint: Read the About terminal on the north wall, then head east through the blast door: the Skills hall is next.

architect.name: Cloud Architect
architect.line: Psst: read up on Cloud-1. Terraform provisions the AWS infrastructure, then Ansible configures the host.
architect.hint: Done with the projects? The Experience gallery is up north, through the door in this room's north wall.

network.name: Network Engineer
network.line: Over in BADASS, VXLAN overlays carry the traffic and BGP EVPN runs the control plane, routed with FRRouting.
network.hint: One room left, through the west door: Contact, where you can reach Youssef.

failure.rebooted: System rebooted: back in the About room, integrity restored.
